summary: Confirmed $48-60, 50 amp, 88 sites, Good Sam and military 10%. Closing Oct 15->Oct 10; added booking, showers. Pin ~330 m off. Note cleaned.
flags: PIN OFF, corrected coords proposed: stored 44.83097,-68.83977 is on the entrance lane near the highway, ~330 m NE of the sites. Imagery puts the loops and pool around 44.8290,-68.8428, in agreement with Google's 44.82890,-68.84277.

GATE: passes. $48 W/E, or $43.20 with the 10% Good Sam. Also Good Sam Park (general 9, facility 8.5, restroom 9.5, appeal 9). Acadia 66 km, no gateway. RV Life campers 7-9/2026: $50-60 motorhomes with Good Sam.
